integrity: All formulas and assumptions are explicitly stated; finite checks support but do not replace the all-size proof. Classical antichain/Dedekind facts are credited; no independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: One atom at a pointed complete finite S5 coordinate-product frame, every local size at least two; independent Bernoulli truth values for the probability law. Does not cover incomplete products, correlated valuations or many-atom joint profiles. Historical priority outside inspected sources remains uncertain.
title: Exact coalition-knowledge profiles and their valuation fibers on finite \(\mathsf{S5}\) products
